summary: Frontend testing completed for countdowns and auto-rejection, role permissions, offers creation/preview, realtime controls, routes, and responsive overflow. Core flows passed, but selected-order detail does not refresh after timer auto-rejection.

ui_bugs.issue: When the selected new order expires, its queue row changes to Rejected but the selected detail remains in the new state with the timer, progress, and Accept/Reject actions; rejected feedback is not shown.

integration_issues.issue: New filter tab text and sidebar badge remain hardcoded as New (3) and 3 after orders are rejected or added, so displayed counts can disagree with queue state.

action_items: Synchronize Orders.selected with the updated orders collection (or derive selected order by id) so timer auto-rejection updates the detail panel and removes its actions/timer.
Derive New filter and sidebar badge counts from current order state instead of hardcoded values.
Replace the intentionally MOCKED frontend-only service adapters before production use; no real persistence or API failure handling is present.
critical_code_review_comments: Orders stores a copied selected order object; App's expiry timer only updates setOrders, so selected detail becomes stale after automatic rejection.
All domain state and integrations remain MOCKED in-memory and are not consumed from frontend/src/services/index.js.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing mock data and fired temporary in-memory test orders.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login, countdown display, manual reject feedback, auto-rejection row state, role restrictions, menu edit disabling, offers create/preview, realtime gating/latency, routes, and 375/768/1024/1440 overflow were exercised. Re-test selected detail after expiry and dynamic counts after fixes.
rca of the issue: In App.js the expiry interval calls setOrders with updated statuses. Orders initializes local selected from orders[0] and only updates selected inside its manual update handler; it does not reconcile selected when the orders prop changes. Therefore the row is rejected while Detail continues rendering the old selected object with status new.
